title: tools.rerun result
description: companion → plugin, the payload of the `result` answering a `tools.rerun` — the `tools.call` result's shape. `result` is the tool's answer as the platform returned it; a call whose arguments were not kept answers the actionable refusal `rerun_unavailable` (`ok: false`, a sentence the model reads). `callUrn` names the NEW call when it ran.
